task: Profile exact-constant curve handling as a bounded temporal-publication latency experiment.

router_attempts.detail: The authoritative repository is on desktop-local X: and is not mounted in the NUCBOX WSL executor.

scope_guards: Do not change production runtime, tests, releases, models, data splits, thresholds or sealed confirmation clips.
Compare exact evaluated motion, priority samples, source action, rig modes, inventory and recovery behavior.
Treat a single default-Rigify headless reference as profiling evidence only.
validation_required: Hash every production runtime input before and after the experiment.
Measure current and candidate smoothing work on the same generated action.
Reject the candidate if any evaluated curve or source-recovery invariant differs.
Do not claim full responsiveness or promote production from this experiment.
